claims.claim_text: Case Number: SC-049
Date of Incident: June 24, 2020
claims.evidence_observations: The title card states 'June 24, 2020 AT 0109 HOURS', which aligns with the claim of June 24, 2020.

claims.claim_text: Time of Incident: Approximately 0110 hours
claims.evidence_observations: The timestamp on the bodycam footage shows '01:12:31' at the start of the clip, indicating the time is approximately 01:12, not 01:10 as claimed.

claims.claim_text: Location: 22851 Loumont Drive, Lake Forest, CA
claims.evidence_observations: The title card states '22851 Loumont Drive, Lake Forest', matching the claim.

claims.claim_text: Reporting Officer: Deputy J. Navarro
Badge Number: 8392
Subject: Kaylee Morgan, Female, 28 years old, all black clothing
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows a person standing on the sidewalk, but it is too dark and distant to confirm if they are wearing all black clothing or if they are female.

claims.claim_text: Officer(s): Deputy J. Navarro, Deputy M. Chen, Deputy R. Vega, Deputy L. Park
Witness(es): Resident at 22851 Loumont Drive
On June 24, 2020, at approximately 0110 hours, I was dispatched to 22851 Loumont Drive, Lake Forest, regarding a residential burglary in progress.
The reporting party, a female, stated via 911 that someone had broken a side window and entered the residence.
The reporting party stated she was hiding in the bathroom and her boyfriend was in a closet.
claims.evidence_observations: The transcript shows the subject stating 'he's hiding in the closet and I'm hiding in the bathroom'.

claims.claim_text: At approximately 0115 hours, I arrived on Loumont Drive, parking three houses east of the target address.
I turned off my headlights and patrol vehicle lights as I approached.
I exited my vehicle and walked west toward 22851 Loumont Drive, using my flashlight to scan the area.
At approximately 0116 hours, while approaching, I observed a gray sedan parked on the north side of the street directly in front of 22855 Loumont Drive.
I heard a sound from my left.
claims.evidence_observations: Audio transcript at 01:46 states 'he's hiding he's hiding yeah where is he hiding we're hiding he's'.

claims.claim_text: I turned and observed the subject standing on the north sidewalk, under a street light, approximately 15 feet south of my position.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows a person standing on the sidewalk under a street light, but it is too dark and distant to confirm if they are approximately 15 feet south of the officer's position.

claims.claim_text: The subject was dressed entirely in black and had the hood of her sweatshirt pulled up over her head.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows a person standing on the sidewalk, but it is too dark and distant to confirm if they are dressed entirely in black with a hood up.

claims.claim_text: I immediately noticed the subject was holding a dark object in her left hand at waist level.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows a person standing on the sidewalk, but it is too dark and distant to confirm if they are holding a dark object in their left hand at waist level.

claims.claim_text: I drew my weapon and illuminated the subject with my flashlight.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows a person standing on the sidewalk, but it is too dark and distant to confirm if the officer drew a weapon and illuminated the subject with a flashlight.

claims.claim_text: I immediately identified the object as a black handgun.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows a person standing on the sidewalk, but it is too dark and distant to confirm if they were holding a black handgun.

claims.claim_text: I ordered the subject: "Let me see your hands! Drop it! Get on the ground!"
claims.evidence_observations: The officer is heard giving commands to the subject, consistent with the claim of ordering the subject to drop the weapon and get on the ground.

claims.claim_text: The subject did not comply with any commands.
claims.evidence_observations: The subject does not appear to comply with the officer's commands during the clip.

claims.claim_text: At approximately 0117 hours, Deputies Vega and Chen arrived on scene in separate vehicles.
I broadcast that I had a suspect at gunpoint.
The subject then raised the handgun to chest height with both hands and began walking across the street in my direction.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows a person walking across the street, but it is too dark and distant to confirm if they raised the handgun to chest height and began walking toward the officer.

claims.claim_text: At 0118 hours, I observed the subject suddenly lower the weapon, turn away from me, and walk back toward the tree line.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows a person walking back toward the tree line, but it is too dark and distant to confirm if they lowered the weapon and turned away.

claims.claim_text: The subject paused briefly, then turned to face me again.
claims.evidence_observations: The subject pauses briefly and then turns to face the officer again, consistent with the claim.

claims.claim_text: I requested a K-9 unit via radio.
At approximately 0119 hours, the subject once again raised the handgun with both hands, pointed it directly at Deputy Vega, and began advancing toward our position.
claims.evidence_observations: The video shows a person raising a handgun and advancing, but it is too dark and distant to confirm if they pointed it directly at Deputy Vega and began advancing toward the position.

claims.claim_text: Deputies Vega, Chen, and I opened fire simultaneously.
claims.evidence_observations: The officer and two other individuals (presumably Deputies Vega and Chen) open fire simultaneously, consistent with the claim.

claims.claim_text: A total of eight rounds were fired by the three deputies within approximately two seconds.
claims.evidence_observations: Three individuals fire weapons within a short timeframe, consistent with the claim of eight rounds fired within approximately two seconds.

claims.claim_text: The subject fell to the ground and released the weapon.
claims.evidence_observations: The subject falls to the ground and releases the weapon, consistent with the claim.

claims.claim_text: At 0120 hours, I approached the subject with Deputies Chen and Vega.
claims.evidence_observations: The officer approaches the subject with two other individuals, consistent with the claim.

claims.claim_text: Deputy Vega kicked the weapon away from the subject's reach.
claims.evidence_observations: One individual kicks the weapon away from the subject's reach, consistent with the claim.

claims.claim_text: Upon inspection, Deputy Vega determined the weapon appeared to be a replica or BB gun.
Deputies assessed the subject's condition and began administering first aid.
At approximately 0125 hours, OCFA Engine #19 arrived on scene.
Paramedics initiated treatment.
At 0134 hours, the subject was transported by ambulance to Mission Hospital.
At approximately 0131 hours, I made contact with a resident at 22851 Loumont Drive.
The resident stated that no one in the household had called 911, and they had been asleep when the commotion began.
Body-worn camera footage (four deputies)
claims.evidence_observations: The video clip shows body-worn camera footage from four deputies, consistent with the claim.

claims.claim_text: Eight (8) cartridge cases
claims.evidence_observations: Eight cartridge cases are visible on the ground after the incident, consistent with the claim.

claims.claim_text: One (1) black handgun (determined to be a BB gun)
claims.evidence_observations: A black handgun is visible on the ground after the subject falls, consistent with the claim (though the claim notes it was determined to be a BB gun).

claims.claim_text: Cell phone belonging to subject
Subject transported to Mission Hospital.
Subject subsequently pronounced deceased.
Scene secured for OCDA investigation.
